008package paint.viewer.io;
009
010import paint.shared.utils.TextFiles;
011import java.awt.*;
012import java.io.BufferedReader;
013import java.io.BufferedWriter;
014import java.io.IOException;
015import java.nio.file.Files;
016import java.nio.file.Path;
017
018import static paint.shared.constants.PaintStringConstants.RECORDING_NAME;
019
020/**
021 * Static utility class providing file operations for the PAINT Viewer, including:
022 * <ul>
023 *     <li>Exporting Swing components as high-resolution PNG images</li>
024 *     <li>Filtering a project's {@code squares.csv} to a temporary CSV</li>
025 *     <li>Automatically opening filtered results via Desktop integration</li>
026 * </ul>
027 *
028 * <p>Instantiation is prevented via a private constructor.</p>
029 */
030public final class FileHelper {
031
032    /** Prevent instantiation. */
033    private FileHelper() {
034    }
035
036
037    // =========================================================================
038    // CSV FILTERING
039    // =========================================================================
040
041    /**
042     * Extracts only the rows from an experiment's {@code squares.csv} matching the
043     * given recording name, writes them to a temporary CSV file, marks the file
044     * read-only, and opens it using the desktop's default CSV viewer.
045     *
046     * <p>If no rows match, an empty CSV (with header) is still produced.</p>
047     *
048     * @param projectRoot   the root directory of the PAINT project
049     * @param experimentName the experiment folder containing {@code squares.csv}
050     * @param recordingName  the recording name to filter for
051     * @throws IOException if reading or writing fails, or Desktop integration is unavailable
052     */
053    public static void filterAndOpenSquaresCsv(Path projectRoot,
054            String experimentName,
055            String recordingName)
056            throws IOException {
057
058        Path origCsv = projectRoot
059                .resolve(experimentName)
060                .resolve("squares.csv");
061
062        if (!Files.exists(origCsv)) {
063            throw new IOException("Squares.csv not found: " + origCsv);
064        }
065
066        // Create temporary filtered file
067        Path tempFile = Files.createTempFile("Squares " + recordingName, ".csv");
068
069        try (BufferedReader r = TextFiles.newReader(origCsv);
070             BufferedWriter w = Files.newBufferedWriter(tempFile)) {
071
072            String header = r.readLine();
073            if (header != null) {
074                w.write(header);
075                w.newLine();
076
077                // Match the "Recording Name" field exactly.
078                //
079                // This used to be line.contains(recordingName), which is a substring test over the
080                // whole row: recording "…-A4-1" then also matched every row of "…-A4-10", and the
081                // user was shown a mixture of two recordings' squares. Fall back to the old
082                // behaviour only if the column is missing, so an unexpected header shows too much
083                // rather than nothing.
084                int nameCol = indexOfColumn(header, RECORDING_NAME);
085
086                String line;
087                while ((line = r.readLine()) != null) {
088                    boolean match = (nameCol < 0)
089                            ? line.contains(recordingName)
090                            : recordingName.equals(fieldAt(line, nameCol));
091                    if (match) {
092                        w.write(line);
093                        w.newLine();
094                    }
095                }
096            }
097        }
098
099        tempFile.toFile().setReadOnly();
100
101        if (Desktop.isDesktopSupported()) {
102            Desktop.getDesktop().open(tempFile.toFile());
103        } else {
104            throw new IOException("Desktop integration not supported.");
105        }
106    }
107
108    /**
109     * Returns the position of a named column in a CSV header line.
110     *
111     * @param headerLine the CSV header line
112     * @param columnName the column to look for
113     * @return the zero-based column index, or {@code -1} if the column is absent
114     */
115    private static int indexOfColumn(String headerLine, String columnName) {
116        String[] columns = headerLine.split(",", -1);
117        for (int i = 0; i < columns.length; i++) {
118            if (columnName.equals(columns[i].trim())) {
119                return i;
120            }
121        }
122        return -1;
123    }
124
125    /**
126     * Returns one field of a CSV line. The files written by PAINT contain no quoted or
127     * embedded commas, so a plain split is sufficient here.
128     *
129     * @param line  the CSV line
130     * @param index the zero-based field index
131     * @return the field, trimmed, or {@code null} if the line has too few fields
132     */
133    private static String fieldAt(String line, int index) {
134        String[] fields = line.split(",", -1);
135        return (index < fields.length) ? fields[index].trim() : null;
136    }
137}
